title: Computation of potential and reference evapotranspiration — Potential-evapotranspiration
text: thornthwaite computes monthly potential evapotranspiration (PE) according Thornthwaite (1948) equation. simplest three methods, can used mean temperature data available. annual heat index computed mean temperature calendar month, least 12 monthly values required. Thornthwaite's original method uses separate table monthly mean temperatures 26.5 ºC higher. implementation applies general equation temperatures, gives somewhat different values range (2% 27.3 ºC). hargreaves computes monthly reference evapotranspiration (ETo) grass crop based original Hargreaves equation (Hargreaves Samani, 1985). However, precipitation data Pre provided modified form due Droogers Allen (2002) used; equation corrects ETo using amount rain month proxy irradiation. Hargreaves method requires data mean external radiation, Ra. Ra available can estimated latitude lat month year. penman calculates monthly reference evapotranspiration (ETo) hypothetical reference crop according Penman-Monteith equation (Monteith, 1965). widely considered accurate method estimating ETo, method recommended UN Food Agriculture Organization (FAO). several methods simplify original Penman-Monteith equation used practice. follow default procedure described Allen et al. (1994), aka `ICID` method. However, versions also implemented can used setting method parameter appropriate value. FAO-56 method (Allen et al., 1998) can used setting method `FAO`, variation American Society Civil Engineers (Walter et al., 2002) used setting `ASCE`. default original parameterization corresponding short reference crop 0.12 m height used, although parameterization tall reference crop 0.5 m height (Walter et al., 2002) can also used, setting crop parameter 'tall'. method requires data incoming solar radiation, Rs; since seldom available, code estimate data bright sunshine duration tsun, alternatively data percent cloud cover CC. Similarly, data actual vapour pressure ed available, possible estimate dew point temperature Tdew, relative humidity RH even minimum temperature Tmin (sorted least uncertain method). Similarly, atmospheric surface pressure P required computing psychrometric constant can calculated atmospheric pressure sea level P0 elevation z, else elevation z assuming sea level pressure 101.3 kPa (FAO-56 eq. 7). elevation z always required penman (default value), since also used compute clear-sky solar radiation, Rso = (0.75 + 2e-5 z) Ra. ratio Rs/Rso used net longwave radiation term limited 1. Wind speed U2 must refer 2 m height, height conversion applied. wind speed data U2 available, constant value 2 m s-1 used. Custom CO2 atmospheric concentration CO2 can also provided, following Yang et al. (2019): term 0.00024 (CO2 - 300) added wind coefficient denominator (0.34 short crop, 0.38 tall crop). correction derived short reference crop, applied whichever crop selected, including 'tall'. soil heat flux G computed difference mean temperature previous following months, using forward backward differences first last time steps. penman works series length; single time step G set 0. function produce error message valid combination input parameters provided. verbose `TRUE` (default value), message produced informing computation options selected. function accepts data variety formats, including 1-D vectors, 2-D matrices 3-D arrays. input data format determine output format. Vector input can used single-station data. Matrix input can used produce output number locations, column matrix considered one location. 3-D arrays can used process gridded data, first dimension time two dimensions representing spatial coordinates. See examples guidance use options. main input object (Tave, Tmin, Tmax) time series function cycle used determine position observation within year (month), allowing data start month different January. time information provided, input data treated sequence monthly values starting January.
